description: API layer + migration attempt. Build the AutoMapper MappingProfile, the global exception middleware, all public and admin controllers (with JWT protection and explicit api/admin/<resource> routes), wire Program.cs DI + pipeline, and attempt the repo-local EF 7 migration (non-blocking). Completing this makes the entire backend build AND boot (Swagger up) without a live DB. Depends on FEAT-002 (needs repos/UoW/ApiResponse/PasswordHasherService/TokenService). Ground every type in design.md §2.9, §2.10, §2.11, §2.13, §2.14, §2.16 and the step-prompt clarifications (categoryId not-found => empty page HTTP 200; 409 on duplicate discount code via GetByCodeAsync; bulk update via GetByIdsAsync).
steps: Create src/Shop.Api/Mapping/MappingProfile.cs: MappingProfile : Profile. Read maps: Product->ProductListItemVM, Product->ProductDetailVM (variants+images), ProductVariant->ProductVariantVM, ProductImage->ProductImageVM, Category->CategoryVM, Order->AdminOrderListItemVM, Order->OrderTrackingVM, OrderItem->OrderItemVM, Discount->DiscountVM, Customer->CustomerListItemVM. Write maps: ProductUpsertRequest->Product ignoring Id,Slug,CreatedAt,IsDemoData and all nav members; DiscountUpsertRequest->Discount ignoring Id,IsDemoData. LowStockItemVM.VariantLabel composed via MapFrom/resolver. XML-doc.
Create src/Shop.Api/Middleware/ApiExceptionMiddleware.cs: catches unhandled exceptions downstream, logs at Error, writes ApiResponse.Fail('Unexpected error',500) with no stack trace leaked. XML-doc.

Create public controllers in src/Shop.Api/Controllers/ ([ApiController], [Route("api/[controller]")], inject IRepoWrapper+IMapper, async Task<ActionResult<ApiResponse<...>>>): CatalogController GET api/catalog?page=&pageSize=&categoryId= (clamp page>=1, pageSize 1-100 default 12; if categoryId is provided but no such category exists return an EMPTY PagedResultVM TotalCount=0 with Message 'Category not found' HTTP 200 — do NOT throw and do NOT ignore the filter; inline // comment on preserved-position pagination) and GET api/catalog/{id} (404 ApiResponse if missing); CategoriesController GET api/categories; CartController POST api/cart/validate (stateless, re-prices each line server-side, reads no Cart row); CheckoutController POST api/checkout (guest order; server-computed totals from trusted prices; OrderNumber format ORD-{yyyyMMdd}-{6 Crockford base32 chars}; unknown/inactive/expired discount code => order placed WITHOUT discount, Success=true, Message explains, HTTP 200; up to 3x regenerate on OrderNumber unique-violation); OrderTrackingController GET api/ordertracking/{orderNumber} (via GetByOrderNumberAsync, 404 if unknown). XML-doc every controller/action.

Create admin controllers in src/Shop.Api/Controllers/Admin/ with explicit routes. AuthController [Route("api/auth")] POST login — NOT [Authorize]: find AdminUser via GetByUsernameAsync, 401 ApiResponse on unknown user/bad password (via IPasswordHasherService.Verify, no user/pass distinction), 403 if inactive, else issue JWT via ITokenService and map TokenVM into AuthenticateResponse. The remaining admin controllers are [Authorize]: AdminProductsController [Route("api/admin/products")] GET/POST/PUT/DELETE(+/{id}) + PUT bulk (load via GetByIdsAsync, apply partial changes, Save(), return count); AdminInventoryController [Route("api/admin/inventory")] GET low-stock (per-row QuantityOnHand<=LowStockThreshold); AdminOrdersController [Route("api/admin/orders")] GET (paged) + PUT {id}/status; AdminDiscountsController [Route("api/admin/discounts")] CRUD (409 ApiResponse on duplicate Code via GetByCodeAsync); AdminCustomersController [Route("api/admin/customers")] GET (paged); AdminSalesController [Route("api/admin/sales")] GET overview?from=&to=. Use a shared paging clamp helper for orders/customers. By-id DELETE uses load-then-delete: GetByIdAsync -> 404 if null -> Delete -> Save. XML-doc every controller/action.

Wire src/Shop.Api/Program.cs DI in order: AddDbContext<ShopContext>(o=>o.UseNpgsql(config.GetConnectionString('DefaultConnection'))); AddScoped<IRepoWrapper,RepoWrapper>; AddScoped<ITokenService,TokenService>; AddScoped<IPasswordHasherService,PasswordHasherService>; AddAutoMapper(typeof(MappingProfile)); AddAuthentication(JwtBearer)+AddJwtBearer(validate issuer/audience/lifetime/signing key from Jwt section); AddAuthorization; AddCors allowing http://localhost:4200; AddControllers; AddEndpointsApiExplorer; AddSwaggerGen with a JWT bearer security definition.

Order the Program.cs pipeline (outermost first): app.UseMiddleware<ApiExceptionMiddleware>() FIRST (before everything), then Swagger+SwaggerUI (Development only), UseCors(angular policy), UseAuthentication, UseAuthorization, MapControllers.

Attempt the EF migration via a REPO-LOCAL tool manifest (non-blocking) from repo root: `dotnet new tool-manifest` (if absent), `dotnet tool install dotnet-ef --version 7.*`, `dotnet tool restore`, then `dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate --project src/Shop.DAL --startup-project src/Shop.Api`. If it succeeds, keep .config/dotnet-tools.json and src/Shop.DAL/Migrations/. If it FAILS for any reason, do NOT block the build — leave ShopContext+model+seed as-is; the exact commands get documented in the README (FEAT-004). The global dotnet-ef 8.0.32 is unusable (no .NET 8 runtime) so it must NOT be used.
acceptance_criteria: MappingProfile passes AutoMapper AssertConfigurationIsValid() (write maps ignore the server-owned members listed); exception middleware returns the ApiResponse 500 shape.

All public controllers (Catalog/Categories/Cart/Checkout/OrderTracking) and all admin controllers exist with the specified routes; admin controllers (except Auth) carry [Authorize]; login is at api/auth/login with no token.

CatalogController returns an empty PagedResultVM (TotalCount=0, Message 'Category not found', HTTP 200) for a nonexistent categoryId; bulk update loads via GetByIdsAsync; duplicate discount Code returns 409.
Program.cs registers DbContext/RepoWrapper/TokenService/PasswordHasherService/AutoMapper/JWT/CORS/Controllers/Swagger and orders the pipeline with ApiExceptionMiddleware outermost.
EF migration is attempted via the repo-local EF 7 tool; failure does NOT break the build.
`dotnet build Shop.sln` completes with 0 errors and the API boots with Swagger up without a live database.
verification: Run `dotnet build Shop.sln` from repo root and confirm 0 errors (must pass whether or not src/Shop.DAL/Migrations/ exists).
Run `dotnet run --project src/Shop.Api` and confirm it starts (Swagger endpoint available) without a live DB, then stop it.
Record in findings whether the InitialCreate migration was generated or skipped (and why).
findings:
Build verified: `dotnet build Shop.sln` => Build succeeded, 0 Warnings, 0 Errors (EXIT=0), no live DB, with src/Shop.DAL/Migrations/ present. All 4 projects compile (MSBuild 17.6.8, SDK 7.0.306). API boot verified: `dotnet run --project src/Shop.Api` reached 'Now listening on: http://localhost:5000' / 'Application started' / 'Hosting environment: Development' with NO errors and NO live PostgreSQL; process stopped after confirming. (Shell on this machine echoes queued commands and reports exit -1 spuriously; real results were captured to log files and read back.)

MIGRATION: GENERATED. Repo-local EF 7 tool manifest created at .config/dotnet-tools.json pinned to dotnet-ef 7.0.20 (dotnet new tool-manifest; dotnet tool install dotnet-ef --version 7.*; dotnet tool restore all succeeded, TOOL_EXIT=0). `dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate --project src/Shop.DAL --startup-project src/Shop.Api` succeeded (MIG_EXIT=0, 'Done.'), EF Core 7.0.20 initialized ShopContext on Npgsql 7.0.18. Generated src/Shop.DAL/Migrations/20261022131034_InitialCreate.cs + .Designer.cs + ShopContextModelSnapshot.cs. Final build WITH the Migrations folder still reports 0/0. The global dotnet-ef 8.0.32 was NOT used (unusable without .NET 8 runtime).

API SURFACE (Shop.Api):
- Mapping/MappingProfile.cs: MappingProfile : Profile. Read maps: Product->ProductListItemVM (CategoryName flattened, PrimaryImageUrl = first image by SortOrder), Product->ProductDetailVM (CategoryName, TotalQuantityOnHand = sum of InventoryItems.QuantityOnHand; Variants/Images auto-mapped), ProductVariant->ProductVariantVM, ProductImage->ProductImageVM, Category->CategoryVM, Order->AdminOrderListItemVM (CustomerName = Customer.FullName ?? GuestName; Status = enum.ToString()), Order->OrderTrackingVM (Status string; Items), OrderItem->OrderItemVM, Discount->DiscountVM (Type = enum.ToString()), Customer->CustomerListItemVM, InventoryItem->LowStockItemVM (ProductName from Product.Name, VariantLabel = 'OptionName: OptionValue' when Variant set). Write maps with explicit Ignore: ProductUpsertRequest->Product ignores Id,Slug,CreatedAt,IsDemoData,Category,Variants,Images,InventoryItems; DiscountUpsertRequest->Discount ignores Id,IsDemoData. (AssertConfigurationIsValid passes by construction.) NOTE: DiscountVM.Type and AdminOrderListItemVM.Status / OrderTrackingVM.Status are STRINGS (enum names).
- Middleware/ApiExceptionMiddleware.cs: catches downstream exceptions, logs at Error with method+path, writes ApiResponse<object>.Fail('Unexpected error',500) as JSON, no stack leaked.
- Controllers/PagingHelper.cs: static Clamp(page,pageSize) => page>=1, pageSize 1-100 default 12. Shared by Catalog + AdminOrders + AdminCustomers.
- Controllers/OrderNumberGenerator.cs: Generate(DateTime) => 'ORD-{yyyyMMdd}-{6 Crockford base32}' (alphabet 0-9A-Z minus I/L/O/U) using RandomNumberGenerator.GetInt32.
- Public controllers ([ApiController],[Route('api/[controller]')]): CatalogController GET api/catalog (clamp; nonexistent categoryId => EMPTY PagedResultVM TotalCount=0 Message 'Category not found' HTTP 200; uses _Category.GetByIdAsync existence check then _Product.GetPagedAsync) + GET api/catalog/{id:int} (Query().Include(Category,Variants,Images,InventoryItems); 404 ApiResponse if missing). CategoriesController GET api/categories. CartController POST api/cart/validate (stateless; loads product via Query().Include(Variants); variant price when VariantId set else BasePrice; 400 on unknown product/variant; reads no Cart row). CheckoutController POST api/checkout (guest order; re-prices each line server-side; discount applied only if found+active+in-window else order placed WITHOUT discount, Success=true, Message explains ('unknown/inactive/expired code'), HTTP 200; percentage/fixed capped to subtotal; OrderNumber with up to 3x regenerate on DbUpdateException; other DbUpdateException => Fail 500 'Could not place order'; Status=Pending). OrderTrackingController GET api/ordertracking/{orderNumber} via _Order.GetByOrderNumberAsync, 404 if unknown.
- Admin controllers in Controllers/Admin/: AuthController [Route('api/auth')] POST login NOT [Authorize] (GetByUsernameAsync; 401 'Invalid credentials' on unknown user OR bad password via IPasswordHasherService.Verify; 403 'Account disabled' if !IsActive; else ITokenService.GenerateToken -> AuthenticateResponse{Token,Expires,Username,Role}). All others [Authorize] with explicit routes: AdminProductsController [Route('api/admin/products')] GET list/GET {id}/POST (Slugify name server-side, CreatedAt=UtcNow, IsDemoData=false)/PUT {id} (map onto tracked + re-slug)/DELETE {id} (load-then-delete 404) + PUT bulk (GetByIdsAsync, apply NewPrice/IsActive/CategoryId when non-null, Save once, return count; 400 if empty ids). AdminInventoryController [Route('api/admin/inventory')] GET low-stock (Query().Include(Product,Variant).Where(QtyOnHand<=LowStockThreshold)). AdminOrdersController [Route('api/admin/orders')] GET paged (clamp; CountAsync before Skip/Take; OrderByDescending PlacedAt; Include Customer) + PUT {id}/status (404 if missing). AdminDiscountsController [Route('api/admin/discounts')] GET/GET{id}/POST (409 'Discount code already exists' if GetByCodeAsync non-null)/PUT{id} (404 + 409 if code collides with different id)/DELETE{id} (load-then-delete). AdminCustomersController [Route('api/admin/customers')] GET paged (clamp; CountAsync before Skip/Take). AdminSalesController [Route('api/admin/sales')] GET overview?from=&to= (window filter on PlacedAt; TotalRevenue/OrderCount/AverageOrderValue from window; LowStockCount is current read-side count independent of window; TopProducts grouped by (ProductId,ProductNameSnapshot), top 5 by QuantitySold).
- Program.cs DI order: AddDbContext<ShopContext>(UseNpgsql DefaultConnection); AddScoped IRepoWrapper->RepoWrapper, ITokenService->TokenService, IPasswordHasherService->PasswordHasherService; AddAutoMapper(typeof(MappingProfile)); AddAuthentication(JwtBearer)+AddJwtBearer(validate issuer/audience/lifetime/signing key from Jwt section); AddAuthorization; AddCors policy 'AngularDevPolicy' WithOrigins http://localhost:4200; AddControllers/AddEndpointsApiExplorer/AddSwaggerGen(+Bearer security definition). Pipeline (outermost first): UseMiddleware<ApiExceptionMiddleware>() FIRST, then Swagger+SwaggerUI (Development only), UseCors(AngularDevPolicy), UseAuthentication, UseAuthorization, MapControllers.

FOR FEAT-004 (frontend + README + docs/14):
- apiBaseUrl must be http://localhost:5000/api (Kestrel :5000 locked). Angular dev origin http://localhost:4200 is the only CORS origin allowed.
- Auth interceptor rule: attach bearer token to any request whose path starts with ${apiBaseUrl}/admin/ ; login (api/auth/login) is OUTSIDE that segment so it carries no token. All admin routes are api/admin/<resource>; public routes are api/catalog, api/categories, api/cart/validate, api/checkout, api/ordertracking/{orderNumber}.
- Response envelope: every endpoint returns ApiResponse<T> { Success, Message, Data, StatusCode }. Catalog list returns ApiResponse<PagedResultVM<ProductListItemVM>> (Items/TotalCount/Page/PageSize) - use TotalCount for preserved-position pagination. Nonexistent categoryId returns 200 with empty page + Message 'Category not found' (not an error). Checkout with a bad discount code still returns 200 Success=true with an explanatory Message.
- Enum-as-string on the wire: DiscountVM.Type, AdminOrderListItemVM.Status, OrderTrackingVM.Status, OrderConfirmationResponse.Status are strings; UpdateOrderStatusRequest.Status is the OrderStatus enum (int/name accepted by model binding).
- Demo admin login: username 'admin' / password 'Admin@12345' (seeded IdentityV3 hash; see FEAT-001 findings). README (FEAT-004) must document the exact EF commands: dotnet new tool-manifest; dotnet tool install dotnet-ef --version 7.*; dotnet tool restore; dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate --project src/Shop.DAL --startup-project src/Shop.Api; dotnet ef database update ... ; and note the global dotnet-ef 8.0.32 is unusable (no .NET 8 runtime).
- OrderNumber format shipped: ORD-{yyyyMMdd}-{6 Crockford base32}; unique index on Order.OrderNumber is the guarantee (3x retry safety net).
- New committed artifacts this feature: .config/dotnet-tools.json and src/Shop.DAL/Migrations/ (20261022131034_InitialCreate.cs/.Designer.cs + ShopContextModelSnapshot.cs).
